goal.request: Prevent internal source-relative analysis language from leaking into the standalone production prompt and causing a downstream image generator or orchestrator to request an unavailable reference image.

evidence.claim: The user reports that the delivered prompt triggered a request to attach a reference image and asks whether the skill instructed that behavior, then authorizes a skill improvement.
The exact production prompt contains the internal phrase 'source-relative' in a foreground-person appearance clause even though the skill promises a standalone prompt.

Before this correction, the official salience-plan validator returned status ok for the motivating prompt because it reconciled literal ledger excerpts but did not audit unresolved external-reference language.

The committed skill already prohibited mentioning the source image, while the pre-correction working tree introduced literal source-relative and source-specific prompt fixtures and no deterministic standalone-output audit.

evidence.claim: The corrected audit rejects the motivating source-relative phrase, other internal provenance labels, unavailable reference/original/source instructions, and source-side placeholders while accepting physical light-source language and self-contained keep, preserve, remain, and stay clauses.

evidence.claim: Source modules, generated artifacts, skill packaging, improver validation, Python syntax, diff hygiene, and the complete reverse-image-prompt test suite pass after regeneration.

perceptual_contract.primary_success_condition: A production prompt remains directly usable after the source image, analysis records, and conversation disappear; internal comparison vocabulary selects the target but never substitutes for stating it.
perceptual_contract.user_appeal: The generated prompt should be pasteable into a new image-generation context without eliciting a request for the original or reference image.

invariants.statement: Source-relative, source-visible, source-specific, source-supported, and current-source semantics remain available inside analysis and ledgers but are compiled out of final prompt prose.
Every retained final clause names the actual visible direction, relation, value, coverage, topology, material response, or capture result rather than an unavailable comparison artifact.
Physical uses such as light source and self-contained keep, preserve, retain, remain, or stay clauses remain valid when their subject and state are named in the prompt.

flexible_dimensions: the literal self-contained target wording selected for each source
physical scene uses of the noun source
whether a self-contained state verb is needed
generator response and rendered pixels pending a new controlled generation

mismatches.source_state: The requested and documented output is a standalone text-to-image prompt whose visual target is fully stated in its own text.
mismatches.render_state: No new render was evaluated; the authored prompt instead contained 'source-relative', causing an outer generation workflow to request an unavailable reference image.

hypotheses.statement: The source-relative contract is valid internally, but emitting its provenance label instead of its literal visual value makes the prompt externally deictic and can trigger reference-image routing.
hypotheses.falsifier: The motivating and held-out provenance phrases remain accepted after the correction, or an equivalent self-contained literal target is rejected.

hypotheses.statement: Ledger reconciliation alone cannot prove standalone usability; adding a narrow literal-text boundary audit will reject unresolved artifact dependencies without banning physical source language or self-contained state verbs.
hypotheses.falsifier: The audit either still passes the known deictic cases or fails the held-out physical light-source and self-contained-state cases.

intervention.general_rule: Keep source comparison and provenance inside analysis, compile it into literal generator-facing visual state, and reject common unresolved internal labels or missing-artifact instructions at the authored-prompt boundary while allowing physical scene uses and self-contained state verbs.
intervention.generalization_basis: The correction is defined by the output dependency boundary rather than one portrait, pose, lighting value, aesthetic label, generator, or case-specific adjective. The motivating phrase is retained only as a regression fixture and unrelated provenance, artifact, physical-source, and state-verb cases exercise the rule.

decision.rationale: The known prompt-actuation regression is now blocked by both skill instructions and deterministic literal-text validation, while unrelated allowed-language cases pass and the package remains structurally valid. This supports a bounded claim that standalone prompt behavior improved. No new full prompt was independently authored with the revised skill, no image was generated, and no pixels or post-change user judgment were evaluated, so render fidelity and user-aesthetic improvement remain unscored.
